review_candidates.title: Delivery Manager
review_candidates.description: The Company: OXBO are partnered with a fast-growing UK IPP delivering utility-scale renewables and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects across the UK. As part of their continued growth, they’re looking for a Delivery Manager. As Delivery Project Manager, you’ll be responsible for leading projects from financial close through to O&M handover. The Benefits: £70,000 - £80,000 salary range + 10-20% bonus. Car allowance on top. Remote working, with site visits as required. Fast-growing IPP with real projects, and a hands off management style. What you will be doing: Lead end-to-end delivery of renewables and battery energy storage (BESS) projects. Manage project budgets, schedules, and risk registers etc. Oversee EPC contractors to ensure compliance with contractual scope. Coordinate internal teams and external consultants across multiple work streams. Engage with landowners, stakeholders, and local communities. Conduct site visits and attend external meetings/events. Monitor and verify commissioning processes (FAT/SAT/SIT). Prepare reports for senior leadership and board-level review. General support of the delivery team and aiding in continuous improvement of delivery processes. What you will bring: 3+ years experience in renewables, energy infrastructure, or BESS projects. Strong understanding of project management principles (PMP or PRINCE2 desirable). Experience working with contractors, landowners, and external stakeholders. Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously. Familiarity with planning tools (Primavera, MS Project, etc.). Knowledge of grid connections and UK energy infrastructure (desirable). Confident communicator with strong stakeholder engagement skills. Self-starter with a proactive, solutions-driven mindset.
